::: {#rem-information-gain}
#### Information gain is mutual information

Draw one point from the node of @def-information-gain,
and let $Y$ be its class and $X$ the branch it falls into.
Then the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) at the node is $\entropyf{Y}$,
the weighted entropy left in the branches is $\entropyf{Y \mid X}$,
and the [information gain](#def-information-gain) is the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) $\mutinfof{X}{Y}$.

:::
